fixes: Reference's right third carries strong orange-red rays (x 80-100%, y 10-55%) and a burnt-orange core just above the burst origin at bottom centre; ours is almost uniformly yellow there, with only a faint orange tint at the top right.
The blue-to-yellow boundary in the reference is a soft, blurry diagonal. Ours is a hard straight edge with a pale white highlight running along it from the left edge (~y 30%) down to the origin.

The reference's brightest near-white rays sit at top centre (x 45-60%, y 0-35%) and fan out from a burst point at about (52%, 95%). Ours puts the brightest pale wedge in the upper left, and the burst point sits further left at about (45%, 95%).
The reference's upper half has broad, deep green masses (x 20-90%, y 10-40%). Ours is lighter and evenly striped there, with no large dark-green bodies.
Our streaks are too fine and too many: dozens of thin parallel lines across the upper half and the lower right. The reference streaks are fewer, wider and softer.

The reference has a pale mint/whitish patch in the centre-left (around x 20-50%, y 35-60%) and yellow-green glints in the lower middle. Ours has no centre-left lightening, and its pale area starts lower and sits further right.

The reference's green mass rises in a stepped shoulder: a mid step around x 30-45% at ~y 60%, then the upper plateau at ~y 30%. Ours goes from the low left step straight up a single diagonal at x ~40-45% to a plateau at ~y 38%, which is too low and has no middle shoulder.
The reference's top edges of the green mass blur upward softly over a tall distance (a fuzzy vertical smear). Ours are cleaner, with horizontally streaked edges.
Ours has grey horizontal streak lines across the cream upper-right area (y 5-25%) that the reference doesn't have; the reference's upper right is a smooth grey-green tint.
Our rainbow fringe along the dark/pale diagonal edge (green-yellow-pink, lower right) is far too saturated and sharp. The reference shows only a faint warm/pinkish tint along that edge.
Our upper right (x 60-100%, y 0-50%) is a flat grey-blue. The reference is a richer periwinkle there, with soft light streaks.
The reference's pale band is brightest near the top centre (almost white-cyan at x 35-55%, y 0-25%) and broad. Ours is dimmer and narrower at the top.
The reference has sharper, thinner pale streaks, almost hairlines, in the left half (y 40-65%) rising to the upper right. Ours are all broad and soft-blurred.
The reference's dark navy band in the lower left (y 78-90%) is thin and crisp, and sits close to the bottom. Ours is wider and softer and sits a little higher.

The reference's magenta-pink along the bottom is more saturated and runs as a band across the bottom 12% from x ~35% to the right edge. Ours is a duller pink-mauve, concentrated in the bottom-right corner.

In the reference the teal-blue sits in the top-left corner (x 0-35%, y 0-20%), with only grey-blue at the top right. In ours the strongest blue is at the top right and the top left is sandy beige with blue streaks.
The reference has a dark burnt-orange/brown bottom-left corner (x 0-15%, y 85-100%). Ours is uniform amber there.

The reference's streaks are gently curved arcs sweeping up to the right, with a pale cream band through the middle-right (y 55-65%) and fine dark hairlines in the bottom amber. Ours are straighter, converge toward the upper left, and have weaker hairlines.
Ours has a dark navy blob at the top centre-left (x 20-45%, y 0-40%). In the reference that area is lighter, more mid-blue, and the navy is spread more evenly across the upper left.
The reference has a distinct lighter streak band running from about (45%, 35%) to the top-right corner along the navy/pale boundary. Ours blends it into a broad, soft gradient.

The reference's oxblood is concentrated at the left edge and bottom-left corner and stays dark up to ~y 50%. Ours spreads the oxblood further right along the bottom (to x ~45%) and makes it a little weaker at the left edge.

The reference's navy mass is much larger and richer: a saturated blue-violet from x ~45% to ~90%, reaching down to ~y 70% on the right. Ours is a narrower, greyer navy that fades out by ~y 50%, and the top-right corner is too light.

The reference's dark-to-pale edge (around x 35-45%) carries a soft prism fringe (cyan plus a hint of red). Ours is a single crisp bright hairline running from (37%, 0) down to about (60%, 70%), too sharp and too long.
The reference's oxblood at the top (x 25-45%) is deeper and wider. Ours is fainter and sits further right (x 35-60%).

The reference's pale diagonal band is much brighter and more cyan (almost white-cyan at the centre and lower middle), and it is wide, covering most of the bottom-left half. Ours is a dimmer blue-grey and narrower.
The reference has a visible prism fringe (pinkish then cyan) along the band's upper edge around (35-45%, 25-40%). Ours has no warm fringe, only faint thin cyan lines.

The reference's bottom-left corner and left edge are light (pale blue with a blue-violet patch at x 0-15%, y 45-70%). In ours the left side and bottom-left corner are a darker slate blue, and fine diagonal hairlines run through the band that the reference doesn't have.
In the reference the navy mass reaches the top edge (faint blue at x 30-55%, y 0-15%). In ours the mass starts at ~y 15% under a wide uniform pale band.
The reference's bottom-right corner is a distinct reddish oxblood (x 75-100%, y 70-100%). Ours is a muted purple-brown there.

Ours has a combed texture of many fine parallel streaks inside the mass and along its top edge. The reference's mass is built from a few broad, smooth strokes, with a soft lilac-pink fringe on its left edge.
Ours has a bright, sharp cyan-white hairline from about (0, 10%) to (35%, 60%). The reference has only a soft cyan glow/fringe along the left side and at the dark/pale boundary.

The reference's pale lower-left region is smaller: it starts at ~y 35% on the left edge and reaches the bottom only to x ~55%. Ours climbs higher up the left edge and spreads further right along the bottom.

The reference has a lighter periwinkle streak in the top-right corner (x 85-100%, y 0-25%) and lighter blue streaks in the lower right. Ours keeps the top right dark and puts its lighter blue band on the right edge at mid height.
The reference's slate blue-grey vertical band (x ~50-62%) runs the full height, mauve-grey at the top. Ours appears only in the lower half, with a broad mauve wash at the top spanning x 45-75%.
The reference has fine vertical streak texture inside the bands (visible striations in the red and peach). Ours is smooth, blobby vertical gradients.
The reference's left edge is a brighter yellow-orange over a wider area (x 0-10%, from y 30% down). Ours confines the yellow to a narrow strip in the lower left.

The reference is one dense, softly blurred coral body filling the centre (x 15-90%), with short feathered tongues at its edges. Ours is a fan of long, separate petals with crisp pale gaps between them, so it reads as a striped radial burst.
The reference has no visible convergence point; its streak blur runs fairly parallel. Ours clearly fans out from the lower right toward the upper left.

The reference's pale blue is confined to the left edge (x 0-10%) and the top-right corner, with lilac at the bottom left and bottom right. Ours puts a large pale-blue area in the top-left quadrant and more blue between petals in the lower left.
The reference's top-left corner (x 0-35%, y 0-15%) is warm red-orange, and the slate grey-blue is confined to the top centre-right. Ours runs the slate band across the full top width.
The reference's upper-middle red (y 20-50%) is a saturated crimson-red. Ours is a muted pinkish crimson.
The reference has visible horizontal streak texture and a broader yellow-orange bottom right. Ours is smooth with no streak detail, and its orange-to-yellow transition at the bottom is weaker.

The reference's purple/cream boundary is a wave: purple runs up the whole left edge (x 0-15%) to the top, the boundary dips to ~y 45% at x 25-40%, then rises to ~y 37% at the right. Ours has a nearly flat, soft horizontal boundary at ~y 40-48%, and the top left is pale lilac-cream instead of purple.
The reference's black wedge at the top right is larger (x 65-100%, y 0-28%), with an olive-yellow tint at its lower edge. Ours is smaller and higher (y 0-15%).

The reference's cream is a bright diagonal tongue running from the top centre down-left to about (25%, 45%), with sharp-ish edges. Ours is a broad, hazy cream band across the full width, with vertical blur streaks dragging into the purple.

The reference's dark-blue mass is a V/wedge: its lower-left edge sweeps diagonally from about (5%, 50%) into the convergence point at ~(25%, 78%), and it is darkest near that point. Ours is a rounded vertical blob, darkest and most uniform at the top.
The reference's mass has internal streaky texture and lighter blue strands. Ours is a smooth flat fill.
Ours has distinct blue radiating streaks in the pale area right of centre (x 40-65%, y 15-60%). In the reference those are much fainter, so the pale right half is almost clean.

The reference's dark rust shape at the left centre is an elongated diagonal stroke rising from the left edge (~y 60%) up to the right, with a red-orange streak along the left edge. Ours is a near-perfect circle with a defined edge at (18-48%, 40-70%).
The reference has a dark rust mass at the bottom centre (x 55-75%, y 85-100%). Ours has none.

The reference has a rust arc across the top centre (from ~(35%, 15%) to the top-right edge at ~y 25%), with a dark spot at the right edge (~y 25-35%). Ours shows only a short diagonal rust streak at the upper right, with no arc toward the centre.
The reference's main peach blob is soft-edged, tilted along a diagonal and positioned at x 55-95%, y 40-80%. Ours is a crisp-edged vertical ellipse sitting higher, at y 32-85%.

The reference's darkest teal sits at the left edge, upper middle (x 0-15%, y 15-50%). Ours puts the darkest green in a diagonal band through the centre (x 40-60%, y 50-85%), and our left edge at mid height is a lighter teal.
The reference's top centre is a light minty green (x 30-70%, y 0-30%). Ours is a mid green there, and our top-right peach is a crisper circle than the reference's soft glow.
